summary.possible_issue: Tokens would still stop working after seven days if the expiry value is left numeric or interpreted as a duration.

summary.possible_issue: A token without an expiry claim may still become unverifiable after signing-key rotation if old verification keys are discarded.
summary.prevention: Keep rotation unchanged in this scoped edit and document that permanent means no fixed age expiry, not guaranteed validity across key retirement.
